boundaries: Lifecycle tests use temporary trees, a finite synthetic local executable, synthetic credentials and only registered dev inputs. They do not call the real model worker, an API, or a model.
The fixture stubs verifyPreflight to isolate runner lifecycle. It is not an end-to-end formal holdout acceptance or an authorization to consume the historical attempt path.
The original real holdout freeze, results, reports and correction archives were not rewritten. Temporary path names holdout-deepseek-1 are synthetic fixture paths only.
The original three failure cases were first observed as 3 failures / 4 adjacent passes, and later repeated with the final test fixture selecting those same three failures.
The missing experiment-lock dependency in an intermediate fixture was an actual setup failure. It is retained separately and not counted as a product regression or a passing test.

stdout and stderr have independent 20,000,000 raw-byte admission bounds. The tests measure pending unpersisted bytes for small chunked events under a delayed disk write, not universal heap usage for every workload.

A genuine disk I/O operation that never settles and malicious unrelated processes mutating the workspace are outside these synthetic liveness checks. Stale lock reconciliation stays manual and fail-closed.
